title: Legacy landfill-derived microplastics in India: terrestrial matrix pathways, spatio-temporal dynamics, and environmental risks
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,667-683
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00606F, Critical Review
Keshar Verma, Sushma Pardeshi, Rita Dhodapkar, Debishree Khan
Microplastics originating from legacy landfills can be transported via leachate, soils, sediments, air, and compost, thereby highlighting multiple terrestrial transport pathways and associated environmental risks.
